name: Frontend Clean Architecture & Component Profile
description: Defines strict separation between dumb Presentational UI components, Smart Containers, Custom Hooks, and API Gateways.

layers.name: PresentationalUI
layers.description: Pure stateless or presentation-only components. Zero API calls, global store mutations, or business logic.

layers.name: SmartContainers
layers.description: State orchestration, routing integration, and binding custom hooks to UI components.

layers.name: StateHooksAndStores
layers.description: Client-side state management, reactive stores, and custom hooks.
